claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Brother sewing machine with a blue-lit display area, but the exact model number (SE630) is not readable.

risks.risk: Exact model may not be SE630 (model number not readable), which affects value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label/plate showing “SE630” (or the exact model number) on the machine body.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Brother computerized sewing machine with unknown model; treat as lower value until model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Not confirmed working: no stitching test, motor sound, or speed control verification.
risks.proof: A short video of power-on and a full stitching test (fabric + needle moving), including speed changes and reverse/forward if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working; assume potential faults and discount accordingly.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual), reducing usability.
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing all included items laid out (feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual) with counts.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal/unknown accessories; value reduced until the full kit is shown.

risks.risk: Condition unknown beyond appearance: possible wear/rust/scratches on moving parts, belt/gear issues, or damaged display.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: needle area, feed dogs, underside/belt area (if accessible), and any visible wear on moving parts; plus a screen/display close-up.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst visible-wear case based on limited photos; treat as used with possible cosmetic/functional wear.

risks.risk: Power/voltage and adapter correctness not confirmed (important in Lagos power conditions).
risks.proof: Photo of the power rating label (voltage/Hz) and confirmation of the exact power cord/adapter included.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming power setup may be incomplete or not confirmed for local use; discount until verified.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the machine’s model label/plate showing the exact model number (confirm whether it is SE630).
Send a short video showing the machine powering on, display working, and a real stitching test on fabric (including speed control).
List and photograph all included accessories/parts (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual) with counts.
Send close-up photos of the needle/feed area and any visible wear (including underside/belt/gear area if possible).
Send a photo of the power rating label (voltage/Hz) and confirm the exact power cord/adapter included.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Brother computerized sewing machine with a blue display, but the exact model (SE630) and working condition are not verifiable from the photos. Without a model confirmation and a stitching/power test, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
